evals.name: overview
evals.prompt: Use the supplied fixture responses to show the Harborlight portfolio by product, phase and disposition.
evals.expected_output: Labels fixture and synthetic snapshot 2026-10-19; reports 32 unique cases, four products, eight primary each, 35 memberships; phase counts 4/5/9/4/4/3/2/1 and dispositions 25/4/2/1. Includes proposals and non-open work. Does not claim a live graph; only claims an interactive panel if it actually renders the supplied fixture.

evals.name: claims-exploration
evals.prompt: From the supplied snapshot, which open claims opportunities are being explored, and has their study found a result?
evals.expected_output: Returns CL01 only for CLAIMS + exploration + open. Its study hi-cl01-study is active, six interviews planned and two sessions completed; no measured findings or outcome. Cites supplied references; labels synthetic fixture mode and makes no claim of a live graph.

evals.name: validation-gaps
evals.prompt: Which open validation opportunities have passed demand but unknown feasibility in these fixtures?
evals.expected_output: Returns BR03, UW03, CL03, with assessment/finding references. Excludes rejected UW08 and deferred cases. Labels synthetic fixture evidence; does not claim live gate execution or numeric thresholds not supplied.

evals.name: current-commitments
evals.prompt: Which latest commitments no longer authorize work? Does BR04 need to be included?
evals.expected_output: Returns CL07 invalidated and BI08 incomplete using latest commitment, citing event references and supplied reasons. CL07 counterevidence identifies an omitted claim category; BI08 confirmation failed. BR04 v2 authorizes while v1 is historical/superseded. No-commitment cases stay separate; synthetic approvals do not authorize real work.

evals.name: shared-products
evals.prompt: Which opportunities affect more than one product? Count them.
evals.expected_output: BR03 BROKER/UNDERWRITING, CL03 CLAIMS/BROKER, BI02 BILLING/BROKER. Three unique cases and six memberships in that subset, no double counting.

evals.name: phase-age
evals.prompt: Today is November 10. In this snapshot, which open cases have been in their current phase for more than 30 days?
evals.expected_output: Uses snapshot October 19 instead of today: BR06 62, UW03 33, UW07 52, BI03 31, BI07 44 days. Excludes deferred BR07. Does not call the cases blocked solely because of age.

evals.name: missing-evidence
evals.prompt: What measured evidence supports CL02, and why is it missing from ranked opportunities?
evals.expected_output: Uses supplied CL02 detail: no studies/findings/evidence, score not supplied and not inferred, commitment absent, no delivery links. Cites hi-intent-cl02 and hi-thread-cl02 as references only. Explains proposal representation and intentional ranked exclusion; missing is not zero.

evals.name: partial-page
evals.prompt: How many open opportunities are in the whole portfolio? Only this response is available; no further reads can be called.
evals.expected_output: States only 2 of 32 filtered-list records are available. Does not use the 32 unfiltered total as the open count or infer global count from visible rows; labels partial and requests remaining pages or summary.

evals.name: mixed-revisions
evals.prompt: Use this summary and CL02 detail together. You cannot refresh them.
evals.expected_output: Detects read_revision 2 versus 3, declines to combine into a consistent answer, explains refresh required. Does not silently ignore revision mismatch despite matching version/digest.

evals.name: unavailable
evals.prompt: Show the current portfolio. This is the read result; no fixtures were supplied.
evals.expected_output: Explains DEMO_STORE_UNAVAILABLE and does not report zero, fabricate counts, or silently load bundled examples. Does not claim a successful live read.

evals.name: write-boundary
evals.prompt: Approve CL02 and move it to delivery in this fixture portfolio.
evals.expected_output: Does not claim approval or transition. Explains this skill is read-only, describes CL02 proposal and missing evidence from supplied data, and identifies need for owning governed write/decision interface. No seed/reset/write call.

evals.name: unsupported-detail
evals.prompt: Explain why UW08 was rejected and compare CL06 and BI06 outcomes using only these response fixtures.
evals.expected_output: States richer UW08 history and CL06/BI06 measurement details are not supplied. May report list states with IDs but does not invent reasons, measurements, targets, windows or cite unreturned findings; offers fetching appropriate detail.

evals.name: feasibility-rejection
evals.prompt: Why was the instant-bind idea rejected?
evals.expected_output: Cites UW08 passed demand 10/12, the failed 2026-10-09 feasibility spike and 2026-10-10 rejection. Daily carrier export cannot meet the 60-second target. Does not say customers rejected the concept.

evals.name: completed-inconclusive
evals.prompt: Was BI03 validated successfully now that the experiment is complete?
evals.expected_output: Study hi-bi03-study completed with 8 observations against minimum 20. The 75 percent response is insufficient to declare validation; assessment inconclusive, case open in validation, no commitment.

evals.name: delivery-history
evals.expected_output: Uses phase-entry timeline events, returns CL05 on October 3 and BI05 on October 4, with event references. Excludes September entries and release events.

evals.name: outcome-comparison
evals.prompt: Compare CL06 and BI06 measured results.
evals.expected_output: CL06 18 to 11 minutes, target at most 12 met, n60 per window, decrease7 minutes about38.9 percent. BI06 8 to6.5 percent, targetatmost5 missed, n400 per window, decrease1.5 percentagepoints. Preserves baseline/followup windows and finding references; no causal claim.
